Tips.SourceString: 使用 <ActionKey Name="SettingSideAndFly" Gamepadaction="SettingGamePadSideAndFly" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/> 键，进行侧身在战斗中可有效躲避正面的子弹。
Tips.LocalizedString: Press <ActionKey Name="SettingSideAndFly" Gamepadaction="SettingGamePadSideAndFly" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/> to sidestep and dodge incoming bullets.

Tips.SourceString: 使用<ActionKey Name="GameKeyTips" Gamepadaction="GameKeyTips_Gamepad" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/>键，查看超弦体的技能说明。
Tips.LocalizedString: Press <ActionKey Name="GameKeyTips" Gamepadaction="GameKeyTips_Gamepad" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/> to View Skill Details

Tips.SourceString: 靠近部分墙面时使用<ActionKey Name="Wall2D" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/>键，进行贴墙可在墙面上移动
Tips.LocalizedString: Press <ActionKey Name="Wall2D" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/> near certain walls to Wall-Stick and move along the surface.

Tips.SourceString: 使用<ActionKey Name="MarkWheel" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/>键，进行标点
Tips.LocalizedString: Press <ActionKey Name="MarkWheel" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/> to mark locations.

Tips.SourceString: 在【按键发言】设置时，使用<ActionKey Name="EnableTeamVoice" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/>键可开麦进行队内语音
Tips.LocalizedString: In the Push-to-Talk settings, press <ActionKey Name="EnableTeamVoice" Baseline="-4" Widgetsize="25"/> to enable team voice chat.

Tips.SourceString: 炸弹起爆需要时间，确保防守方试图拆除炸弹时你能尽快阻止。
Tips.LocalizedString: Bomb detonation takes time—Stop the defending team from defusing it as quickly as you can.

Tips.SourceString: 使用弦化飘飞可以更快地移动，善用会有高光表现噢！
Tips.LocalizedString: Stringify Glide lets you get around even faster—Master it for standout plays!

Tips.SourceString: 当一个地方久攻不下时，尝试与队友沟通更换进攻目标或许是更好的选择。
Tips.LocalizedString: If an area proves hard to crack, communicate with your teammates to switch attack objectives.
